summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed an early warning report on Form 6-K regarding its stake in Blue Ant Media. Due to Blue Ant's issuance of 5,857,979 subordinate voting shares for its Thunderbird acquisition, Fairfax's ownership diluted from 22.5% to 17.9%. Fairfax then bought 550,000 shares, raising its stake to 19.9% of 27,719,367 shares outstanding. It holds for investment purposes and may engage in future transactions with Blue Ant's board. This is a passive stake disclosure; no tender, premium, or recommendation mentioned. Watch for further stake changes or strategic moves.
